title: Waste of my money
text: This box was a waste of my money.  I only took it for the one month because they had clove in 3 of the 4 teas and I cannot tolerate clove...it nauseates me.  I let them know that I was surprised and upset that they would have 3 teas in one box with that kind of profile and I was only met with the suggestion to move my subscription to their website where I could customize my box.
label: negative
